title: Frequency Domain Reservoir Computing
abstract: arXiv:2606.24969v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While the quadratic sequence-length bottleneck of transformers has fueled a resurgence in recurrent models, effectively capturing complex dynamics requires architectures that balance efficient training with highly expressive latent states. Echo State Networks (ESNs) offer a compelling approach by utilizing fixed recurrent weights to circumvent backpropagation through time, enabling a closed-form training solution. However, achieving the expressivity needed for complex tasks demands large reservoirs, exposing an $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ state-update bottleneck that prevents ESNs from matching the scale of contemporary recurrent models. To address this limitation, we introduce Frequency Domain Reservoir Computing (FRESCO), an ESN architecture operating entirely in the frequency domain while avoiding domain-shift overheads to achieve $\mathcal{O}(N)$ complexity for dense, non-linear updates via structured circulant recurrence. translated_abstract: 尽管 Transformer 的二次序列长度瓶颈推动了循环模型的复兴，但要有效捕获复杂的动态特性，需要一种能够兼顾高效训练与高度表达性潜在状态的架构。回声状态网络通过利用固定的循环权重来规避时间反向传播，从而获得闭式训练解，提供了一种极具吸引力的方法。然而，要在复杂任务中达到所需的表达能力，需要使用大规模储备池，这暴露出 O(N²) 的状态更新瓶颈，使 ESN 难以匹敌当代循环模型的规模。为解决这一局限，我们提出了频域储备池计算（FRESCO），这是一种完全在频域中运行的 ESN 架构，同时避免了域转换带来的额外开销，通过结构化的循环递归实现稠密非线性更新的 O(N) 复杂度。通过采用……
tldr: 提出FRESCO——一种完全在频域运行的回声状态网络架构，通过结构化循环递归将稠密非线性状态更新的复杂度从O(N²)降低到O(N)。
en_tdlr: FRESCO, a frequency-domain Echo State Network architecture that leverages structured circulant recurrence to reduce dense non-linear state updates from O(N²) to O(N) complexity.
